shots.title: Forward pilot
shots.voice: It's for the planners who load feeder ships at ports like Laem Chabang. Port calls cost about ninety billion dollars a year, so every one percent is about a billion. The pool a better plan can act on: about two point three billion a year. That's a projection, not a result. A forward pilot, built to scale: more compute for the search, a larger model for reading.

numbers.means: port-call cost exposure, USD a year (projection)
Laem Chabang by share of calls, million USD a year (projection), in the take's lower third

shots.delivery: Lead with who it's for, then the $90 billion bill, then the pool. Never cut 'That's a projection, not a result'.

lines: Three Meta models: Muse Glimmer 30B, fine-tuned by us as StowLM Reader, reads the planner's words on the laptop · Muse Spark reads paper and chooses tools · Muse Voice Transcribe hears the radio
Plans by Frontier Engine 0.13.0, our search software. Every plan shown has been through the full checker; a plan that doesn't pass says which rules it breaks.
Try to break it: https://amk-bot.github.io/StowLM/replay/ · Code: https://github.com/AMK-bot/StowLM
Built 26 Oct – 4 Nov 2026 for the Meta hackathon · built for the Thai freight world my family works in

Measured on synthetic ships and cargo at a simulated Laem Chabang-style port. Designed for up to 195 boxes in a half-ship section of feeder ships of 500 to 800 TEU, up to 70 % of that section, an empty section on a ship whose other bays hold fixed synthetic cargo, one loading call. Research pilot, not for use on a real ship.
Radio voice: stock text-to-speech, generated · Narration: {narration} · Music: Sascha Ende, ende.app (CC BY 4.0) · Edit kit adapted from brag (latent-spaces, MIT)
Try to break it: https://amk-bot.github.io/StowLM/replay/ · Code: https://github.com/AMK-bot/StowLM
